goal: Every commit the merge strategy lands carries harness-derived Flywheel-Task, Flywheel-Run, and Flywheel-Phase trailers, with agent-authored Flywheel-* trailers replaced and every landed tree byte-identical to its pre-stamp tree.

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- GitWorktreeSubmitter._submit (both the clean-FF leaf and the rebase leaf), _ff_merge, _reverify, _standing_verify, _commit_count, WORKTREE_COMMIT_IDENTITY_* constants; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_strategy.py -- SubmitRequest carries task_id, run_id, task_file; phase derives via phase_of_task_file (worker.py); read-only reference for the trailer value sources
packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/test_landing_record.py -- keep green, assertions unmodified; also the real-git harness pattern to mirror for the new test module
references: docs/strategy.md -- the landing decision tree the stamp slots into; every leaf stays a land or a park-with-reason
constraints: Stamping is mechanical and worker-side: it runs inside _submit under the merge lock, rewriting the task branch's base..branch commit messages before the fast-forward, on both the clean-FF and rebase paths; agent cooperation must not be required for any criterion to hold
Message-only rewrite: for every landed commit the tree object is byte-identical to the corresponding pre-stamp commit's tree, in order

Agent-authored Flywheel-Task/Flywheel-Run/Flywheel-Phase trailers are stripped and replaced with harness-derived values (task id and run id from SubmitRequest, phase from the task file's phase directory)
Export the trailer key names and value derivation as shared module-level constants/helpers -- the pr strategy and the fw show lookup tasks consume them in later tasks
Stamping must leave verification sound: the tree that passes _reverify and _standing_verify is the tree that lands
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not touch the pr strategy (packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/pr.py) -- a dependent task owns that surface
Do not install git hooks into worktrees or sandboxes
Do not add store schema columns, tables, or new domain-event kinds
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Criterion 1: an agent that commits with no trailers at all still lands with all three keys on every landed commit -- git log --format='%(trailers:key=Flywheel-Task,valueonly)' over the landed range prints the task id once per commit with no empty lines
Criterion 3: a commit forged with Flywheel-Run: forged-123 lands with the real run id and git log --grep='forged-123' over the landed range matches nothing
Criterion 4 mutation: an implementation that re-commits worktree state (new trees) must fail the behavior test's ordered rev-parse <c>^{tree} comparison
A commit already carrying correct harness values is normalized, not duplicated -- exactly one instance of each trailer key after landing
Zero-commit DONE landings and non-DONE terminal paths are byte-identical to today (no stamping, existing cleanup/park behavior)
Both landing layouts still work: in-tree merge --ff-only when the base is checked out, out-of-tree fetch when [submit] base names a separate branch
